missionPremise.ruling: OPS-16 A-020, 2026-08-19. Scoring was never a standing capability: twelve county writers ship in hauska-engine and three scorer CLIs in this repo, and every other row in county_facet_coverage came from a one-off lane script run once. No recompute route existed until this week because there was nothing to re-run.
missionPremise.verifiedAtSourceNotRelayed: The dispatch's central claim was re-derived against the live deployment store rather than accepted: 6 of 14 rails hold ZERO rows in county_facet_coverage (roads, footprint, easement, rrc-wells, rrc-pipelines, rail-corridor) = 1,524 of 3,556 cells = 42.9%, county_manifest count VERIFIED 254. Sharper still, and not in the dispatch: 1,561 of 1,739 live ledger rows (89.8%) were written by an instrument that is not checked into any repo, and two of the three one-off scripts are not on this machine at all, so their rows cannot be reproduced from source by anyone.

completionPredicate: A stranger can make a new rail's coverage measurable by editing one declaration file when its measurement kind exists, and can re-run any rail's scoring at will and read from the run's own report what moved and what did not. Mechanized guards exist for registry-vs-rail-dimension divergence, facet-key-equals-rail-key, no clamping, absence-requires-a-basis-and-reach, and threshold-from-one-source.
completionPredicateMet: YES for the capability, with the boundaries in scopeBasis. The equivalence evidence is 6 counties x 7 rails, not statewide, and is quoted that way throughout.

theCapability.contract: A rail declares HOW IT IS MEASURED. The declaration carries: railKey (which IS the facet written, by construction), a measurement kind plus its parameters, a REQUIRED denominator spec (machine kind plus prose counting rule), an instrument id, a verification method, and optionally an absence probe with an explicit source REACH. It deliberately does NOT carry a threshold: that lives in COUNTY_RAIL_DECLARATION and is read from there, so thresholds have exactly one home.
theCapability.howARailBecomesScoreable: If its measurement kind already exists: add one entry to RAIL_SCORING_DECLARATION in lib/railScoring/registry.ts. Nothing else. If it needs a new kind: add one function in lib/railScoring/measure.ts against the RailMeasurer interface, plus that entry. The split is stated in the file header rather than oversold as 'no code ever'.
measurementKindsShipped: atom-count-over-parcel-features (geometry, cad, flood, landuse, owner) — the dominant shape; it is what countyGeometryScoreCli, countyFloodScoreCli and score_cad_rails_fast.mjs each re-implemented
unspecified — a rail declared with no rule, REFUSED by the engine so it can never be scored as an accidental zero
howARunIsTriggered: CLI: tsx artifacts/api-server/src/countyRailScoreCli.ts --rail=<key> [--county=<fips>] [--cells] [--apply]. Dry run is the DEFAULT; writing requires an explicit --apply.
HTTP: POST /api/county-ledger/score (service token), query rail=, county=, dryRun=1, cells=1, reassessAbsences=1
HTTP: GET /api/county-ledger/score/registry (anonymous) — what is scoreable and what is not, with each unscoreable rail's reason and owner
theCapability.howItIsIdempotent: Not by 'the upsert has ON CONFLICT'. checked_at and last_verified_at move on every write, so a run counting rows would report every cell as changed every time. The run reads each existing row BEFORE writing and diffs by VALUE (railCellChanged; the two timestamps are not in the value type at all), so a second run over unchanged sources reports cellsChanged 0. A separate cellsCoverageMoved counts only cells whose percentage or rail state actually moved, because a first run under a new instrument legitimately rewrites provenance on every cell it touches.
theCapability.howTheDenominatorTravels: Every scored cell writes a canonical provenance string into artifact_path: scorer=1;rail=<key>;kind=<measurementKind>;num=<n>;den=<n>;denKind=<kind>[;detail=...], with a formatter, a parser, and a round-trip test. The parser REFUSES anything it did not write (legacy artifact_path values return null rather than a half-populated object that would read like a measurement). Every run report carries each rail's denominator kind AND its prose counting rule next to the numbers, and names its county-target basis.
theCapability.relationshipToSSW7: Two legs of one pipe, not two entry points. score is WRITTEN to SCORED (source tables -> county_facet_coverage); recompute is SCORED to SERVED (county_facet_coverage -> county_ledger_snapshot). Same prefix, same service-token auth, same advisory-lock and dryRun discipline, same before/after readback discipline, and the score response's nextStep field points at the recompute. Distinct lock namespaces so the two never block each other, with a test asserting that.

handoffToSSW14.whatIsReady: The registry is the drop-in point. A spec that names a measurement kind already shipped becomes a declaration entry and nothing else.

whatEachSpecMustSETTLE.roads: numerator (road-node atoms? OSM ways? county roadway features?), denominator (parcels with frontage? road-mile ceiling?), and whether a county with no acquired layer is not-yet or an established absence
whatEachSpecMustSETTLE.footprint: the denominator above all: footprints are not per-parcel, so a parcel-feature denominator would push an unclamped ratio past 100 routinely. This is the rail where WRITTEN exists in 174 counties and SCORED is empty, so it is the highest-value one.
whatEachSpecMustSETTLE.easement: mostly an ABSENCE spec: what positively establishes 'no recorded easement layer for this county', since the declared source is a county honest-absence default with a CAD exception
whatEachSpecMustSETTLE.rrc-wells: MUST carry an absenceProbe with reach 'enumerated-counties', never 'statewide'. The source is a Harris-only mirror and the engine will refuse a statewide absence claim it cannot back.
whatEachSpecMustSETTLE.rrc-pipelines: its own denominator; a per-parcel ratio is the wrong shape for linear features
whatEachSpecMustSETTLE.rail-corridor: a statewide absence probe is plausible here (single national source) where it is not for rrc-wells; the spec must establish that rather than assume it
whatEachSpecMustSETTLE.mud: recover or re-rule the l16-score-mud.mjs measurement; do not reconstruct it from its own output

handoffToSSW14.ifWeDisagree: report rather than reconcile silently, per the dispatch. Two concrete places we could: whether landuse is the CAD-roll owner-gated join or the land-use-fact atom count (the registry chose the atom count because that is what wrote the live rows, and says so), and whether geometry's denominator is raw or accounted (F9).
